jobs.description:
Ready to bridge innovation and operations in one of the Nordics' most recognized media brands?

Egmont IT is looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer profile who thrives on improving and automating cloud environments, while understanding the importance of stability, governance, and performance.

You’ll join Egmont’s Cloud Operations team, working primarily with Azure, AWS and partially in GCP. Egmont’s cloud footprint is very large and requires that all engineers think about automation and streamlining first.

Your Role & Impact

We are looking for a colleague that is great at asking questions and challenging decisions. We want to build a modern, strong and scalable platform for our many subsidiaries(120+ companies) and we need the right people to do that.

You will be doing hands-on work on our many platforms and solutions to ensure that we constantly improve on new solutions. As well as evaluating old implementations to determine when it is time to modernize.

Responsibilities

• Operate and optimize Egmont’s multi-cloud environments

• Automate routine and repetitive tasks and streamline operations.

• Strengthen observability and proactive monitoring in our tools – We use Datadog

• Use Infrastructure as Code to manage changes and enforce standard and detect drift

• Drive modernization initiatives to reduce manual work and promote automation

• Collaborate with developers, security, and infrastructure teams and business stakeholders to ensure stability and compliance

• Contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and help evolve our culture

What You’ll Bring (Qualifications)

We're looking for a blend of technical expertise and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

Desired Skills

• Experience from previous cloud engineering, operations or DevOps roles

• Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (GCP is also a plus)

• Scripting skills in any popular language

• Experience with IaC tools, any apply but we use Terraform

• Good understanding of networking

• Experience working with modern observability tools like Datadog

• Knows how to setup, configure and operate server based infrastructure, running both Linux and Windows

• Working with source control in GitHub or similar providers

• Experience in agentic tooling and a curiosity in following latest trends

Personal Qualities

You can build, automate, and optimize, but you also know that reliability, performance, and security are the foundation of success. You’re curious, pragmatic, and want to be part of a team that’s rethinking how cloud operations are done.

Why Egmont?

At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. Flexible hybrid work setup (Copenhagen HQ + home office). A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Ready to join?

Logistics & How to Apply

• Location: Vognmagergade 11, 1120 Copenhagen K, Denmark

• Application deadline: November 14, 2026

• Interviews: Will be scheduled from week 47.

Please send your application as soon as possible — we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English.

To apply, please use the "Apply" button on this page. Note that we do not accept applications via email.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact Sabine Lübcke (Senior IT Manager, Cloud & Network) at sabine.lubcke@egmont.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

Join us in this role where you will contribute to the development and implementation of our global workplace strategy and translate business requirements into effective, future-focused workplace solutions. Working closely with internal specialists and external partners, you will bring together the expertise needed to shape solutions aligned with our global Love Your Workplace concept. You will lead workplace projects from early location analysis and space planning through workplace programming, where data, business requirements, work patterns and stakeholder needs are translated into clear workplace requirements and design briefs. The role combines workplace project leadership, strategic space management, data analytics, and stakeholder engagement, with a strong focus on workplace experience and performance.

**Welcome to Global Real Estate & Workplace Management

**You'll be part of Workplace Development, a team within Global Real Estate & Workplace Management (GREWM). Together, we're responsible for developing and evolving Love Your Workplace, our global workplace concept for how offices are designed, used, and experienced across the organization. We collaborate with colleagues across Facilities Management, IT, People & Culture, Procurement, Security, and business leadership to create workplaces that support collaboration, wellbeing, productivity, and sustainability.

As a team, we bring together diverse professional backgrounds and expertise to continuously improve workplace experience for our colleagues around the world. You'll join a collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued and where you'll have opportunities to influence workplace solutions across our global portfolio.

**You'll play an important role in:

**

• Implementing and managing global workplace concepts, standards and policies, while driving the adoption and continued reinforcement of activity-based working

• Translating organizational, functional, and employee requirements into practical workplace solutions and a clear project-specific vision

• Leading workplace projects from pre-project planning and location assessment through programming, design, delivery, implementation, handover, and post-occupancy follow-up

• Advising on space requirements and supporting real estate and lease-selection decisions through test fits and workplace data

• Leading and coordinating the development of project briefs, zoning principles, test fits, layouts, and design plans in collaboration with decision-makers and workplace ambassadors

• Applying and continuously improving occupancy and capacity-planning methodologies

• Identifying opportunities for right-sizing, consolidation, and portfolio optimization, and supporting workplace business cases and project prioritization

• Supporting in collecting and analyzing real estate, people, occupancy and utilization data and converting findings into actionable recommendations

• Using and contributing to the development of workplace KPI and benchmarking frameworks to support evidence-based decisions

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• Bring strong workplace project leadership skills, combined with strategic workplace understanding and solid end-to-end project management experience, preferably from workplace, office fit-out or implementation of ABW projects.

• Understand workplace from both a built-environment and user perspective and are passionate about creating great workplace experiences

• Are curious and ambitious about the future of the workplace and how workplace solutions can continuously evolve to meet changing business and user needs

• Have strong analytical capabilities within occupancy, capacity, utilization and portfolio planning, and can communicate complex findings clearly

• Understand how workplace performance can be evaluated through user experience, occupancy, utilization and other workplace performance measures, and use these insights to continuously improve solutions

• Can effectively coordinate multiple projects and priorities at the same time

• Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across different functions, seniority levels and cultures

• Communicate clearly and confidently, whether discussing workplace concepts with senior leaders or supporting users through workplace change

• Enjoy working collaboratively and influencing outcomes through engagement and partnership rather than formal authority

• Are structured, proactive and able to navigate a complex international organization with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

• Are willing to undertake occasional business travel, primarily within Central Europe and the UK

• building strong relationships with senior sponsors, regional and local stakeholders, business leaders and cross-functional partners

**Maybe you've read the above and can see you have some transferable skills

**Even if your experience doesn't match every requirement, we'd still like to hear from you. We recognize that valuable skills and perspectives come from different industries and backgrounds. Finding the right colleague matters more than a specific location, so we're open to candidates based in Denmark, London, or Warsaw. If you're excited about creating great workplace experiences and believe you can contribute to the team, we encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application as soon as possible. We'll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we've found the right candidate

**Join a global leader in renewable energy

**Ørsted is a growing green energy major and a global leader in climate action. Here, you'll contribute to creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. You'll work alongside skilled colleagues in an international environment where trust, collaboration, learning, and development are part of everyday life. We offer opportunities to grow your career while helping shape solutions that have a positive impact on both people and society.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

jobs.occupation: Customs & Trade Compliance Professional, Assens, DK / Global Customs & Trade Compliance
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by ensuring full compliance in a complex and fast-evolving regulatory landscape? As our new Customs & Trade Compliance Professional, you'll play a key role in safeguarding STG's global trade flows and reducing customs-related risk. You'll work closely with Planning, Customs & Transportation, Procurement, and Finance to keep customs processes compliant, efficient, and well-documented.

What your day will look like

• Manage and follow up on import and export procedures to ensure compliant, timely customs flows

• Monitor and implement customs legislation changes and country-specific obligations

• Set up and oversee customs regimes such as EMCS (Excise Movement and Control System), IPR (Inward Processing Relief), and bonded warehouse processes

• Classify products and determine valuation and origin (HS – Harmonized System, ECS – Export Control System, FTA – Free Trade Agreement) for accurate declarations and duty management

• Support SAP-based customs processes as a basic user (training provided)

• Conduct regular risk assessments and manage customs claims, with proactive mitigation and clear documentation

Keystakeholders

Material Planning · Customs & Transportation · Procurement · Finance · Manufacturing · Tax/Legal · IT/Reporting · SST · Warehousing

What you'll bring

• Proven experience in customs & trade compliance, including hands-on work with import/export processes and customs regimes

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in declarations and documentation

• Analytical ability to interpret and apply legislation

• Proactive, service-oriented mindset with strong stakeholder collaboration skills

• Danish language proficiency and valid Danish ID Card

• Working proficiency in English

Nice-to-have: Descartes software experience

• Advantage: experience with AEO (Authorised Economic Operator), UCC (Union Customs Code), CBAM (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism), EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation), or customs audits

Working at STG & What to expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.  At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 432,000–648,000 annually corresponding to the level of the position, expected experience and responsibilities.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Our recruitment process

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you’ll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:.

• Recruiter screening

• First round: interview with the Hiring Manager - 1 hour, technical depth

• PI assessment

• Second round: interview with a Senior Stakeholder – 30–45 min

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.

Do you enjoy turning complex process and operational data into meaningful improvements? And would you like to help build a more connected, data-driven way of monitoring and improving global processes?

As our new Senior Specialist, Global Process Monitoring, you will help make the health of our global Order-to-Cash processes visible, measurable and actionable. You will work across functions and regions to identify systemic issues, uncover their root causes and ensure that sustainable improvements are implemented at the source, rather than repeatedly resolving the same symptoms.

Your role

Joining Global Operations Excellence, you will take ownership of global process monitoring, bringing together insights from local process-monitoring teams across our Distribution Centres.

Through regular end-to-end monitoring, you will transform process and ERP data into early warnings, actionable insights and clear improvement priorities. With a global overview of process performance and bottlenecks, you will help ensure that the right issues receive the right attention from Distribution Centres, Global Process Owners and other key stakeholders.

You will work closely with colleagues across Operations, Application Management, Master Data, Global Business Services, Data & Analytics, Digital & Technology and Finance. You will also help identify opportunities where analytics, data and AI-enabled capabilities can improve operational performance and create measurable business value.

Key responsibilities

• 
Own the global process-monitoring approach, incorporating insights from local teams across our Distribution Centres.

• 
Proactively identify issues and improvement opportunities throughout the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process.

• 
Turn process and ERP data into early warnings, root-cause insights and actionable recommendations.

• 
Govern and prioritise the global issue-resolution backlog together with Global Process Owners and Distribution Centres.

• 
Drive alignment across regions, Distribution Centres and global functions to support continuous process improvement.

• 
Identify opportunities for AI-enabled process optimisation.

• 
Build strong partnerships across Operations, Data & Analytics, and Digital & Technology.

• 
Support the adoption of increasingly data-driven and AI-enabled ways of working across Operation.

What you bring

You combine a strong analytical mindset with the ability to influence, collaborate and create progress across functions. You are comfortable navigating complex processes and can translate data and operational insights into clear priorities and sustainable improvements.

We imagine that you have:

• 
Approximately three to five years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

• 
Experience within analytics, performance management, process improvement or operational excellence.

• 
A strong understanding of KPI frameworks, business-performance measurement and data-driven decision-making.

• 
Experience working across multiple operational functions, ideally within an international or global environment.

• 
The ability to influence stakeholders and establish alignment across teams and functions.

• 
An understanding of modern analytics, data governance and AI-enabled business capabilities.

• 
A bachelor’s degree within Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Analytics, Data Management or a related discipline.

• 
Experience working with reporting and analytics platforms, together with strong Microsoft Office skills.

• 
Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Your personal qualities

You are curious, proactive and motivated by solving problems at their source. You approach challenges with a strategic and analytical mindset, while remaining collaborative and approachable in your work with others.

You communicate complex topics clearly, make considered decisions and maintain momentum across different stakeholder groups. Most importantly, you bring a continuous-improvement mindset and a genuine interest in how data, technology and AI can contribute to better business processes

Additional information

• Global Career Band 5A

Did we get your attention?

If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive.

Join Diatec A/S

At Diatec, we work with the sales, service, and support of advanced audiological and diagnostic solutions for hospitals, clinics, and hearing care centers across Denmark.

We are part of Interacoustics' global network and are based at our headquarters in Middelfart.

We are looking for a Student Assistant who would like to join a dedicated team and gain hands-on experience in customer service, administrative tasks, and marketing.

Your Responsibilities

As a Student Assistant, you will have a varied role with responsibilities including:

• Coordinating and handling repairs in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

• Preparing and shipping equipmentPlanning and following up on service tasks

• Creating and closing service orders in our systems

• Providing customer support via phone and email

• Handling administrative tasks and ad hoc assignments across the organization

We Imagine That You

About Diatec A/S

Diatec A/S is a Danish sales and service company specializing in advanced audiology and balance products.

We are part of Demant's global network and are based at our headquarters in Middelfart.Driven by innovation, quality, and a strong focus on customer service, we work every day to help our customers with solutions that make a difference.

Interested?

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions, and expertise to help people hear better. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries where we create life-changing hearing health and high-end audio and video solutions. William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and among the 25 most traded stocks.

Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Senior Consultant, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups — locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

We are looking for highly motivated and ambitious Senior Consultant who can contribute across a broad spectrum of projects — including implementation, optimization, and ongoing consulting for the commercial area (SFE,CRM). The role is open to candidates with either a technical background or a business consulting mindset, as long as you bring curiosity, structure, and a collaborative spirit.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, helping clients translate business goals into scalable, system-supported solutions.

Your responsibilities include:

• Lead workstreams or small teams on client projects, ensuring high-quality delivery and stakeholder alignment.

• Conduct process assessments and define future-state operating models across commercial functions.

• Translate business needs into system requirements and support end-to-end implementation of platforms.

• Facilitate workshops, gather requirements, and manage documentation (e.g., project plans, RAID logs).

• Support IT and commercial strategy definition, including CRM optimization and system integration.

• Drive change management activities, including training design, stakeholder engagement, and adoption planning.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, bringing structure, insight, and industry best practices.

• Engage in Sales processes by taking part in RfP responses and delivering presentations.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience ideally in project-based roles within consulting or the life sciences sector implementing solutions for the commercial area.

• Required consulting and hands-on experience in Salesforce, Veeva, and other CRM systems (certifications in Salesforce and Veeva will be a plus). Technical understanding is a plus, especially for projects involving IT collaboration.

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Strong communication skills, both verbal and written in English.

• Ability to create compelling presentations and confidently present to diverse audiences.

• Proactive mindset with a “can-do” attitude and eagerness to learn.

• Comfortable working in agile teams and remote environments.

• Project Management and Agile methodologies experience (certifications on Agile, PMP... will be a plus).

• Experience facilitating workshops and driving client expectations into sustainable solutions.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage change at scale.

• It will be a plus if you have these additional capabilities:

• Experience working in global or regulated industries (e.g., pharma, finance).

• Prior consulting experience — especially in top-tier consulting firms — is valued but not required.

• Exposure to enterprise platform rollouts or system integration projects.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.

• Experience contributing to Salesforce Effectiveness initiatives, including CRM usage optimization, sales process alignment, and support for user adoption strategies.

• Interest in emerging technologies and AI.

This position is offered in Denmark.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

• Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning

• Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice

• Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines

• Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

Senior Manager, Group Development & Strategy

Help shape Coloplast’s growth agenda by sourcing, evaluating and executing strategic transactions across our global business.

The opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager to join Group Development & Strategy at our headquarters in Humlebæk. The role will have a primary focus on M&A while also contributing to selected enterprise strategy projects. You will help develop Coloplast’s M&A agenda, build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities across our business segments, support the M&A Director on key priorities and independently lead selected projects.

The transaction scope spans acquisitions, divestments, minority equity investments and strategic partnerships, as well as integration planning. This is a hands-on role with significant exposure to senior leaders, business segments, global functions and external advisers.

Welcome to Group Development & Strategy

You will join a team of five high-performing specialists across strategy, business development and M&A. Together, we work across group strategy, strategic projects, transactions and post-merger integration, collaborating closely with Executive Leadership and teams across the organisation. You will become part of a distinctive performance culture focused on working together to achieve the best results.

Your key responsibilities includes

•    Support the development of the enterprise M&A strategy and strategic priorities across our business units

•    Source opportunities and maintain the pipeline across acquisitions, divestments, equity investments and partnerships

•    Assess potential targets, including strategic fit, value and key risks, in collaboration with internal stakeholders

•    Support the M&A Director on key transactions and independently lead selected processes

•    Prepare financial models, valuations and business cases

•    Coordinate due diligence across relevant functions

•    Manage relationships with targets, owners and external advisers

•    Support integration planning and the handover to the business

•    Prepare proposals and recommendations for senior management and other internal stakeholders

•    Monitor market, competitor and transaction trends relevant to Coloplast

•    Support on selected enterprise strategy and integration projects

What we expect from you:

•    A relevant commercial master’s degree or MBA

•    5–6 years of experience within M&A and ideally with strategic projects

•    Experience from top-tier consulting, investment banking and/or private equity

•    Strong financial and business modelling skills and hands-on M&A execution capabilities

•    Experience across all phases of a transaction

•    Experience managing multiple high-priority projects simultaneously

•    Fluent written and spoken English

•    Experience working in an international environment

•    Experience from healthcare or medical devices industry is an advantage, but not a requirement

How you work

You are intellectually curious and comfortable moving between the big picture and detailed analysis. You create momentum in ambiguous situations, challenge constructively and know when to involve others. You build trust across functions and geographies, remain composed under pressure and balance analytical thoroughness with the pace required in live transactions.

Role details

Location: Humlebæk, Denmark

Team: Group Development & Strategy

Reports to: Group Development & Strategy Director

Travel: Some international travel should be expected, particularly during active transactions.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible for onshore and offshore pipeline operation, inspection, engineering and integrity tasks as well as asset management of the Danish onshore and offshore pipelines and terminals bringing most of the Danish oil and gas into Denmark.

**Welcome to Asset Integrity

**You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the  offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and  offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and  trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

Working at Ørsted

In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

Shape the future with us

jobs.description:
The Project Management Office at AU Herning is looking for a student assistant to carry out various administration projects as they relate to various research projects, project administration, and course administration at AU Herning.

We are looking for a student assistant who can assist with the following tasks:

• Various administration tasks with the PMO team

• Administration work on different research grants, both within Denmark and the EU

• Daily administrative tasks using Microsoft Suite, Adobe, and other programs

• SOME management for international research projects

• Regular communication with international partners for research projects

• Regular administrative tasks such as data entry, data gathering, and testing interfaces.

• Assistant with planning and working events hosted by the department

Who we are looking for:

• You must be enrolled at AU Herning

• You must thrive in an environment where precision and accuracy is important, and you can stay focused and selfdirected on various tasks

• You have good analytical skills

• Have a good grasp on the English language

Who we are

BTECH is part of Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University – a top 100 university. Aarhus BSS has achieved the triple-crown AASCB, AMBA and EQUIS accreditations.

BTECH is located in the business-oriented and entrepreneurial city of Herning. The department excels in business, IT and engineering disciplines and emphasises the importance of company collaborations. We have around 1,200 students and close to 100 academic staff members. Each year, approximately 500 students are involved in company projects in more than 250 companies ranging from SMEs to leading multinationals. Our incubator Business Factory launches 10 new companies each year.

We influence society through business development and technology. For this reason, many research projects are conducted in close collaboration with industry on the basis of new data and new technologies. These projects are generously supported by the ERC, Horizon Europe, the Independent Research Fund Denmark and the Danish Industry Foundation, among others.

More information about BTECH is available here.

Further information

For further information about the position and the department, please contact Emily Tynes: tel. +45 4189 3353; email emily@btech.au.dk

If you need help uploading your application or have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Supporter, Charlotte Thomsen, tel.: +45 8716 5362; email: charlotte@au.dk.

Practical information

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 1 December 2025.

The average number of working hours is 8 hours weekly.

The place of work is Birk Centerpark 15, 7400 Herning

It is a permanent position which means for as long as you are a student.

Application deadline

15 November 2026

Application

If you are interested in applying for the position, please send:

• A short motivated application

• CV

• Enrolment certification

Terms of employment

You will be employed as an hourly-paid student assistant under the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Organisations of Public Employees – Denmark (OAO-S Collective Agreement, State Sector), as well as the organisational agreement for clerical employees, laboratory technicians and IT staff (HK).

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment to its 37,000 students (FTEs) and 8,700 employees and has an annual revenue of EUR 1.106 billion. Learn more at www.international.au.dk/

Are you ready to shape the tax function of an international shipping company?

Clipper is enhancing its internal tax capability as part of a continued focus on strengthening governance and decision support across the organisation. We are therefore looking for a dedicated and hands-on Tax Manager to be based at Clipper’s headquarters in Copenhagen.

Today, tax matters at Clipper are handled across Finance, Legal and external advisors. With increasing regulatory complexity and risk exposure, we are establishing a more formalized and proactive tax function. The Tax Manager will play a key role in building this capability and embedding robust tax governance across the organization.

You will report directly to the CFO and work closely with the Head of Legal & Corporate Affairs and Head of Controlling and external advisors.

What will be your responsibilities

You will be responsible for both strategic and operational tax matters across Clipper’s global activities. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Establish and maintain Clipper’s tax governance framework, including a tax risk register and clear processes for identifying, assessing and managing tax risks.

• Review the tax implications of material transactions and challenge tax positions and advice from external advisors where relevant.

• Own and oversee transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, benchmarking and documentation.

• Monitor and manage cross-border tax matters, including withholding tax, freight tax and permanent establishment risks.

• Oversee compliance with Danish tonnage tax requirements, including calculations, documentation and relevant controls.

• Coordinate corporate tax, VAT and employment tax compliance and reporting across jurisdictions, ensuring timely filings and robust documentation.

• Advise on tax matters related to international employee mobility and contractor arrangements.

• Monitor relevant tax and regulatory developments, including OECD Pillar Two and environmental and emissions-related taxes, and assess their impact on Clipper.

• Act as Clipper’s internal tax expert and trusted sparring partner, advising management on tax implications of strategic and operational decisions.

What we are looking for

At Clipper, our employees shape our work environment, so bringing a positive attitude is essential.

• We imagine that you have a relevant educational background within finance, tax, business administration, law or similar, combined with solid experience in corporate and international tax.

• You have hands-on experience with tax governance and tax risk management, combined with strong knowledge of transfer pricing, cross-border taxation and international tax principles.

• You are comfortable working with external advisors while also challenging and validating tax positions when needed.

• You are structured and analytical, but also pragmatic and commercially minded.

• You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and turning complex tax matters into practical advice and solutions for the business.

• You communicate confidently across functions and levels of the organisation and are fluent in both Danish and English.

• Shipping experience, including knowledge of tonnage tax or other shipping-specific tax matters, is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

If you’re enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the ideal candidate for this position, or for another opportunity with us.

What you will love about us

At Clipper, you will become part of a growing and professional work environment where we strive to be the best. We offer:

• A key role with significant influence on Clipper Bulk's tax framework and risk profile

• The opportunity to build and shape an internal tax function

• Close collaboration with senior management and exposure to strategic decision-making

• A welcoming and inclusive work environment with a variety of socal, sports, and cultural events throughout the year

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health, dental and critical ilness insurance

• Beautiful office facilities in Nordhavn, located near the metro with on-site paring, delicious lunch arangement and access to fitness facilities and a personal trainer.

Application and recruitment process

Please submit your CV and cover letter through our application portal by 22nd November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be treated with full discretion.

The recruitment process consist of two interview rounds. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first interview, while candidates progressing to the second round will be asked to complete a personality assessment beforehand. Confidential reference checks will be conducted for final candidates.

Learn more about Clipper at clipper-bulk.com, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Clipper is an industry leader in dry bulk, an operator, a pool manager, and a specialist in steel services. We operate a modern fleet of approximately 120 handysize and supramax vessels, transporting a wide range of cargo from dry bulk to break bulk. Clipper is commercially headquartered in Copenhagen and employs a staff of around 100 onshore worldwide__. We are a global workplace built on five shared values: Dependable, Curious, Collaboration, Hands-on and Family. We believe in learning from one another and welcome people with a growth mindset and ambition.

Sustainability initiatives - we strive to make a positive impact. As a maritime player with a global presence at sea and onshore, we recognize our social, environmental, and ethical responsibility. We push for positive development by responsibly running our business and promoting sustainable business behavior in our network. Read more about sustainability initiatives on our website_.

In this role, you will lead and support a few development teams while working closely with Product Owners, Architects and other stakeholders to create high-quality software solutions.

As a Development Manager, your primary focus will be leadership, team development, delivery and creating an environment where engineers can thrive and do their best work. We also believe you are curious about emerging technologies and interested in how AI can support software development, collaboration and innovation.

Key responsibilities

• Lead, coach and support some development teams

• Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing engineering culture

• Support team members in their professional growth and development

• Ensure effective ways of working, agile processes and continuous improvement

• Collaborate with Product Owners and other stakeholders to align priorities and deliveries

• Drive recruitment, onboarding and team development activities

• Help teams remove obstacles and improve delivery capabilities

• Follow up on team goals, performance, engagement and work environment

• Encourage experimentation and learning around new technologies, including AI-driven tools and workflows

Role qualifications

We believe you have the following experience, capabilities and personal skills to succeed in this role:

• A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or related field

• Previous experience in a leadership role within software development

• A background in software engineering or technical product development

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Experience working with agile development methodologies

• The ability to balance people management with business and delivery needs

• A coaching and supportive leadership style

• An interest in AI and how new technologies can improve the way teams work and deliver software

• Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken

What we offer

This is a full-time, permanent position. At IST, we apply an office-first policy, meaning we primarily work from the office as we believe physical presence fosters collaboration, innovation, and a strong team spirit. At the same time, we understand the importance of flexibility—if you live farther away, working from the office three days a week with the remaining time remote may be possible. In Scandinavia our offices are located in Stockholm, Växjö, Roskilde and Oslo.

Interested in this role?

About Us

At Bagel Bites, good food and good service go hand in hand. Following a small restructuring of our management team, we are now looking for someone who can take responsibility for the day-to-day delegation of tasks and administration.

Responsibilities

As Restaurant Manager, you will play a key role in the daily operation of the restaurant. Your primary responsibilities will include:

• 
Developing the company’s overall marketing strategy.

• 
Supervising restaurant employees, effectively delegating tasks, and handling customer matters.

• 
Potentially managing the company’s social media accounts.

• 
Contributing to financial administration, including budgeting, reporting, and accounting.

Qualifications

We are looking for a qualified candidate with the following skills and competencies:

• 
Relevant education or experience in management, preferably within the restaurant or service industry.

• 
Communication skills to develop effective marketing messages.

Application

If you believe your experience and skills match our requirements, we encourage you to send your application and CV to info@sundsult.dk or rkbgaps@gmail.com, with the subject line: “Application Manager.”

Dansk

Om os:

Hos Bagel Bites går god mad og god service hånd i hånd, og efter en lille omrokering af vores ledelse søger vi nu en person, som kan stå for den daglige uddelegering af opgaver og administration.

Ansvarsområder:

Som restaurantmanager vil du være en nøglefigur i den daglige drift af restauranten. Dine primære ansvarsområder vil omfatte:

• 
Udvikling af virksomhedens overordnede markedsføringsstrategi.

• 
Opsyn med restaurantens ansatte, effektiv uddelegering af arbejdsopgaver samt kundehåndtering.

• 
Evt. administration af virksomhedens sociale medier.

• 
Bidrag til den økonomiske administration, herunder budgettering, rapportering og regnskabsarbejde.

Kvalifikationer:

Vi søger en kvalificeret kandidat med følgende kompetencer:

• 
Relevant uddannelse eller erfaring inden for ledelse, gerne inden for restaurant- eller servicebranchen.

• 
Kommunikationsevner til at udforme effektive markedsføringsbudskaber.

Ansøgning:

Hvis du mener, at din erfaring og dine kompetencer matcher vores krav, opfordrer vi dig til at sende din ansøgning og dit CV til info@sundsult.dk eller rkbgaps@gmail.com med emnet: ”Ansøgning manager”.
